Seattle, Washington · stay

Hotels in Seattle for cyclists

Places to stay in Seattle when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Seattle to Portland Bicycle Classic.

Hotels in Seattle for cyclists, listed

  1. University Inn (Staypineapple)

    $$ · 4140 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    A short ride to the STP start lot; mid-priced U District hotel.

  2. Graduate Seattle

    $$$ · 4507 Brooklyn Ave NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Full-service hotel a few blocks from campus with a restaurant and bar.

  3. Watertown Hotel (Staypineapple)

    $$ · 4242 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Sister property to University Inn, same distance to the start.

  4. College Inn Hotel

    $ · 4000 University Way NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Budget European-style inn on the Ave, closest to campus.

  5. Residence Inn by Marriott Seattle University District

    $$$ · 4501 12th Ave NE, Seattle, WA 98105

    Suites with kitchens, useful for an early breakfast before a 5 a.m. start.
